description: Given a task description, recommend which Codex model and reasoning effort to delegate it with. Runs no model call; applies a documented matrix reconciled against the installed catalog.

priority.description: Bias the reasoning effort: quality raises it, latency and cost lower it. Default balanced.

task_description.description: What the delegated task involves, in one or two sentences.

working_dir.description: Absolute directory whose Codex configuration and model catalog should be used. Defaults to this server's own.

name: codex_recommend
title: Recommend a Codex model and effort
